scope: Finite public-source-derived wire contract for the offline gate. Not login compatibility, server acceptance, signer verification or credential-host approval.
qualifications: actual signing unverified: seal/sign are an injected opaque provider; no independent signer or envelope vectors exist (research spec, Static-route assessment 2026-11-16).
ifencrypt is the pinned library's integer 1 (password_client.py:284); the APK caller passes a boolean true flag. Server acceptance of either JSON type is unverified.

Final form bytes follow the installed aiohttp 3.11.16 serializer (vendor/AIOHTTP_SERIALIZER_EVIDENCE.json); upstream declares aiohttp unversioned, so the author's runtime serializer version is unknown.

Country routes are conditional static public-cloud fallback candidates absent proprietary/configured overrides (COUNTRY_ROUTE_EVIDENCE.md); numeric codes are not unique countries; no active runtime provider is proven.
Business value bounds (lengths, character classes, gid scalar forms, token charset) are fail-closed narrowings chosen by this gate, not server schema evidence.
Response selectors are the library's tolerant recursive selectors, recorded for Task 2; they are not a proven server response schema and the boundary does not parse responses.

form.encoding: urllib.parse.urlencode(pairs, doseq=True, encoding='utf-8') over source insertion order (quote_plus)
evidence: aiohttp 3.11.16 client_reqrep.py:580-591 wraps dict in FormData
aiohttp 3.11.16 formdata.py:123-139 urlencode(doseq=True, encoding=utf-8), content type without charset for utf-8

business_json.post_data: base64(nonce12 || AES-GCM ciphertext || tag16); decoded length = 28 + len(business_json)

envelope.sign_format: lowercase hex, 64 characters (generic signer hexdigest; PetSafe signer unverified)
envelope.excluded_source_behaviour: Profile-less defaults (EU URL, bizDM=ipc, version strings) at client.py:80-81,118-143 are not used; every non-literal value comes from the opaque provider.

evidence: client.py:203-209 gid forwarded unchanged from the homes response

value_types.country_code: string key of country_routes; must equal the route's country_code
value_types.email: str, 3-254 chars, exactly one '@', printable, no whitespace (password_client.py:274 selects the email branch on '@')
value_types.login_token: str, 1-1024 printable ASCII chars, no whitespace (password_client.py:283 str(token['token']))
value_types.group_id: int 1..2**63-1 (not bool) or str matching [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}; Task 2 must pass the exact HOMES-selected value

response_selectors.transport: JSON object with 'result' (base64 AES-GCM, optional gzip) else errorCode/code, errorMsg/msg (client.py:154-161, 57-64)
response_selectors.product_id: No source-supported product selector for the group device list; productId/product_id appears only for thing.m.device.get (password_client.py:444), which is outside this contract.
response_selectors.server_directed_url_policy: never followed; any value differing from the current route is a terminal rejection (source behaviour at password_client.py:293-294,388-395 is not reused)

country_route_evidence: COUNTRY_ROUTE_EVIDENCE.md: getApiUrlByCountryCode -> getDefaultRegion(Context,String) -> getDefaultRegion(String) static fallbacks 1->AZ, 91->IN, 7->RU, unmatched->EU (44 is the evidenced unmatched GB/IM code); packaged mobileApiUrl records AZ/EU/IN/RU. Unknown, CN/AY, empty/timezone and override routes are unsupported.
unsupported: Telephone/mobile login variants (password_client.py:42-47,357-386): not in this contract.
thing.m.device.get credentials (password_client.py:48,397-445) and thing.m.device.dp.publish (client.py:223-242): never emitted.
Token endpoint retries/fallbacks (password_client.py:304-330) and server-directed endpoint replacement (password_client.py:388-395): not reused.
AY/CN route: no packaged host; rejected.
Independent PetSafe signer/envelope vectors: none exist; actual signing unverified.
Product verification from the group device list: no source-supported selector (see response_selectors.product_id).
